copied. With the zero value all names map to _other.

fields.name: Names
fields.doc: Names at zero maps all plan, limit and meter names to _other.
fields.default: Names at zero maps all plan, limit and meter names to _other.

configs.name: quotaotel.TraceConfig

fields.name: Names
fields.doc: Names is validated and copied; zero normalizes names to _other.
fields.default: Names is validated and copied; zero normalizes names to _other.

fields.name: Identity
fields.doc:
Identity optionally returns attributes to include in traces. Nil discloses none. At
most four candidates are checked. Only namespaced scalar attributes outside quota.*,
error.*, gen_ai.* and mcp.* are kept. Keys are at most 64 bytes; string values are at
most 128 bytes. Duplicate keys are dropped. Prefer a keyed digest. It remains linkable
personal data and does not anonymize the caller.
fields.default: Identity optionally returns attributes to include in traces. Nil discloses none.

fields.name: Remaining
fields.doc:
Remaining discloses coarse usage per subject, even without caller attributes.
Remaining defaults to false.
fields.default: Remaining defaults to false.

fields.name: MarkErrors
fields.doc:
MarkErrors sets Error status only when an unavailable store causes a request to be rejected.
MarkErrors defaults to false.
fields.default: MarkErrors defaults to false.

fields.name: MaxEventAttrs
fields.doc: MaxEventAttrs includes the dropped marker: zero selects 16; otherwise 1–32.
fields.default: MaxEventAttrs includes the dropped marker: zero selects 16; otherwise 1–32.

fields.name: Failures
fields.doc: Failures optionally counts recovered panics; nil does not count failures.
fields.default: Failures optionally counts recovered panics; nil does not count failures.

fields.name: Logger
fields.doc:
Logger optionally receives fixed diagnostics, at most once per minute per
constructed hook. Recovered values, caller data and error text are never logged.
fields.default: Logger optionally receives fixed diagnostics, at most once per minute per constructed hook.

configs.name: quotaprom.LifecycleConfig
configs.doc:
LifecycleConfig configures bounded call counters. Names are validated and
copied. With the zero value all names map to _other.

fields.name: Names
fields.doc: Names at zero maps all plan, limit and meter names to _other.
fields.default: Names at zero maps all plan, limit and meter names to _other.

configs.name: quotastripe.Config
configs.doc:
Config selects one immutable namespace and state history within a Stripe account. New
copies maps and slices; the application owns Client, Store and callbacks. Callbacks must
be safe for concurrent use and honor their bounded contexts.

fields.name: Namespace
fields.doc:
Namespace is required and identifies one account's immutable state history. The event
index preserves the first customer and meter mapping across replay.
fields.default: Namespace is required and identifies one account's immutable state history.

fields.name: Store
fields.doc: Store is required, concurrency safe, and caller-owned.
fields.default: Store is required, concurrency safe, and caller-owned.

fields.name: Client
fields.doc:
Client is required and caller-owned. An owned copy refuses redirects. Any RoundTripper
is supported behind an HTTPS wrapper.
fields.default: Client is required and caller-owned.

fields.name: APIKey
fields.doc:
APIKey is required and supplies a key under a request deadline. One callback runs at a
time; concurrent callers wait within their own bounded contexts. Keys are cached only
in memory and never logged. Dispatch resolves or reuses a validated key before claiming
work. A failure before claiming writes nothing, reports OnError with operation
"dispatch", and pauses dispatch with escalating backoff.
fields.default: APIKey is required and supplies a key under a request deadline.

fields.name: APIKeyTTL
fields.doc:
APIKeyTTL defaults to one minute; require 1 second–15 minutes. A validated key is
shared by workers and reads for this duration after resolution. Expiry, 401/403,
validation failure and Run start clear it. Shorter TTLs reduce key memory residency and
rotation delay but increase callback traffic. In-flight requests may finish with their
admitted key.
fields.default: APIKeyTTL defaults to one minute; require 1 second–15 minutes.

fields.name: Meters
fields.doc:
Meters contains 1–256 source-meter mappings; New takes a private copy. Meters is
required; configure 1–256 mappings.
fields.default: Meters is required; configure 1–256 mappings.

fields.name: Ignore
fields.doc: Ignore contains at most 256 pure ignored source meters; default empty.
fields.default: Ignore contains at most 256 pure ignored source meters; default empty.

fields.name: Customer
fields.doc:
Customer is required. Its first event-specific result is durably indexed. Return
ErrSkip to skip the event permanently. Any other error pauses export and retries.
fields.default: Customer is required.

fields.name: Drained
fields.doc:
Drained reports whether final source usage through the chosen cutoff has arrived.
Nil leaves source completeness unknown.
fields.default: Nil leaves source completeness unknown.

fields.name: Window
fields.doc: Window defaults to one minute; other nonzero grids are rejected.
fields.default: Window defaults to one minute; other nonzero grids are rejected.

fields.name: Lateness
fields.doc: Lateness defaults to two minutes before automatic sealing. Nonzero values must be positive.
fields.default: Lateness defaults to two minutes before automatic sealing. Nonzero values must be positive.

fields.name: ResendWithin
fields.doc:
ResendWithin defaults to 12 hours from the persisted first send
intent; require RequestTimeout + 5m < ResendWithin < 23h55m.
fields.default: ResendWithin defaults to 12 hours from the persisted first send intent; require RequestTimeout + 5m < ResendWithin < 23h55m.

fields.name: DedupeRetention
fields.doc:
DedupeRetention defaults to 72 hours after window end; unresolved work pins it.
Valid range 1 minute–10 years; it must match StoreConfig.
fields.default: DedupeRetention defaults to 72 hours after window end; unresolved work pins it.

fields.name: DecisionRetention
fields.doc:
DecisionRetention defaults to 35 days; valid range 1 minute–35 days.
It must match StoreConfig.
fields.default: DecisionRetention defaults to 35 days; valid range 1 minute–35 days.

fields.name: ReceiptRetention
fields.doc:
ReceiptRetention defaults to 400 days; MaxHistory can shorten actual coverage.
Valid range 1 minute–10 years; it must match StoreConfig.
fields.default: ReceiptRetention defaults to 400 days; MaxHistory can shorten actual coverage.

fields.name: LeaseTTL
fields.doc: LeaseTTL defaults to two minutes; require >=3*RequestTimeout and <=24 hours.
fields.default: LeaseTTL defaults to two minutes; require >=3*RequestTimeout and <=24 hours.

fields.name: BacklogAlarm
fields.doc: BacklogAlarm defaults to 30 minutes for OnBacklog.
fields.default: BacklogAlarm defaults to 30 minutes for OnBacklog.

fields.name: SummaryLag
fields.doc: SummaryLag defaults to 15 minutes and must be positive. It is a heuristic, not a processing SLA.
fields.default: SummaryLag defaults to 15 minutes and must be positive.

fields.name: RequestTimeout
fields.doc: RequestTimeout defaults to 30 seconds; require 0 < timeout <=5 minutes.
fields.default: RequestTimeout defaults to 30 seconds; require 0 < timeout <=5 minutes.

fields.name: RatePerSecond
fields.doc: RatePerSecond defaults to 20 for each shared POST/read budget; maximum 1000.
fields.default: RatePerSecond defaults to 20 for each shared POST/read budget; maximum 1000.

fields.name: Burst
fields.doc: Burst defaults to one; maximum 1000 per budget.
fields.default: Burst defaults to one; maximum 1000 per budget.

fields.name: Workers
fields.doc:
Workers defaults to eight concurrent group workers; require 1–64. Each group has at
most one local request in flight. All workers share rate budgets and the account
authentication pause. Run cancels and joins them.
fields.default: Workers defaults to eight concurrent group workers; require 1–64.

fields.name: MaxAttempts
fields.doc: MaxAttempts defaults to 50; require 1–1000. Auth responses do not count.
fields.default: MaxAttempts defaults to 50; require 1–1000.

fields.name: MaxDedupeEvents
fields.doc:
MaxDedupeEvents defaults to 100000 per billed group, matching StoreConfig.
Nonzero overrides must be 1–1000000 and must match StoreConfig.
fields.default: MaxDedupeEvents defaults to 100000 per billed group, matching StoreConfig. Nonzero overrides must be 1–1000000 and must match StoreConfig.

fields.name: MaxDecisions
fields.doc:
MaxDecisions defaults to 100000 per terminal/counter shard, matching StoreConfig.
Nonzero overrides must be 1–1000000 and must match StoreConfig.
fields.default: MaxDecisions defaults to 100000 per terminal/counter shard, matching StoreConfig. Nonzero overrides must be 1–1000000 and must match StoreConfig.

fields.name: MaxOpenGroups
fields.doc:
MaxOpenGroups defaults to 10000 retained groups, including internal shards.
Redis group counting is approximate across slots; matching StoreConfig is required.
Nonzero overrides must be 1–1000000 and must match StoreConfig.
fields.default: MaxOpenGroups defaults to 10000 retained groups, including internal shards. Redis group counting is approximate across slots; matching StoreConfig is required. Nonzero overrides must be 1–1000000 and must match StoreConfig.

fields.name: MaxUnsentBatches
fields.doc:
MaxUnsentBatches defaults to 10000 open/sealed/sending/uncertain/quarantined
records per group, matching StoreConfig.MaxBatches. Sent receipts are excluded.
Nonzero overrides must be 1–1000000 and must match StoreConfig.
fields.default: MaxUnsentBatches defaults to 10000 open/sealed/sending/uncertain/quarantined records per group, matching StoreConfig.MaxBatches. Nonzero overrides must be 1–1000000 and must match StoreConfig.

fields.name: MaxQuarantined
fields.doc:
MaxQuarantined defaults to 10000 per group, matching StoreConfig.
Nonzero overrides must be 1–1000000 and must match StoreConfig.
fields.default: MaxQuarantined defaults to 10000 per group, matching StoreConfig. Nonzero overrides must be 1–1000000 and must match StoreConfig.

fields.name: Logger
fields.doc:
Logger is optional and caller-owned; default silence. Logs use fixed fields,
bounded response classifications and only the last four customer characters.
fields.default: Logger is optional and caller-owned; default silence.

fields.name: OnError
fields.doc:
OnError is optional and may run concurrently; it must be concurrency safe,
honor its bounded context and not block.
fields.default: OnError is optional and may run concurrently; it must be concurrency safe, honor its bounded context and not block.

fields.name: OnBacklog
fields.doc: OnBacklog is optional; it must honor its bounded context and not block.
fields.default: OnBacklog is optional; it must honor its bounded context and not block.

configs.name: quotastripe.StoreConfig
configs.doc:
StoreConfig bounds authoritative state. Zero fields select finite defaults.
Prefix is a physical Redis prefix; Namespace remains part of the normalized
group digest. Per-group caps are exact; Redis MaxGroups is approximate across
cluster slots. Retained groups include persistent sequence/fence tombstones
and never expire. Every nonzero capacity must be in [1, 2^30].
DedupeRetention and ReceiptRetention must be 1 minute–10 years. Constructors
copy settings and retain the optional Clock callback.

fields.name: Prefix
fields.doc:
Prefix defaults to quotastripe; use <=32 lowercase letters, digits or underscores. An
optional namespace: prefix accepts a namespace of up to 32 lowercase letters, digits,
underscores or hyphens (for example myapp:prod).
fields.default: Prefix defaults to quotastripe; use <=32 lowercase letters, digits or underscores. An optional namespace: prefix accepts a namespace of up to 32 lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens (for example myapp:prod).

fields.name: Clock
fields.doc: Clock is an optional concurrency-safe clock for isolated tests; default store time.
fields.default: Clock is an optional concurrency-safe clock for isolated tests; default store time.

fields.name: DedupeRetention
fields.doc: DedupeRetention defaults to 72 hours, measured strictly after window end.
fields.default: DedupeRetention defaults to 72 hours, measured strictly after window end.

fields.name: DecisionRetention
fields.doc: DecisionRetention defaults to 35 days; require one minute through 35 days.
fields.default: DecisionRetention defaults to 35 days; require one minute through 35 days.

fields.name: ReceiptRetention
fields.doc: ReceiptRetention defaults to 400 days; history capacity may evict sooner.
fields.default: ReceiptRetention defaults to 400 days; history capacity may evict sooner.

fields.name: MaxDedupeEvents
fields.doc:
MaxDedupeEvents defaults to 100000 per billed group. Index shards allow
MaxDedupeEvents+MaxDecisions entries, additionally limited by MaxBytes.
fields.default: MaxDedupeEvents defaults to 100000 per billed group.

fields.name: MaxDecisions
fields.doc: MaxDecisions defaults to 100000 per terminal shard or daily-counter shard.
fields.default: MaxDecisions defaults to 100000 per terminal shard or daily-counter shard.

fields.name: MaxGroups
fields.doc:
MaxGroups defaults to 10000, including internal shards and permanent tombstones.
It is exact per MemoryStore and approximate per namespace across Redis slots.
fields.default: MaxGroups defaults to 10000, including internal shards and permanent tombstones.

fields.name: MaxOpenWindows
fields.doc: MaxOpenWindows defaults to 1000 per group.
fields.default: MaxOpenWindows defaults to 1000 per group.

fields.name: MaxBatches
fields.doc: MaxBatches defaults to 10000 unresolved records per group, including open work.
fields.default: MaxBatches defaults to 10000 unresolved records per group, including open work.

fields.name: MaxQuarantined
fields.doc: MaxQuarantined defaults to 10000 per group; quarantined input never expires.
fields.default: MaxQuarantined defaults to 10000 per group; quarantined input never expires.

fields.name: MaxHistory
fields.doc:
MaxHistory defaults to 10000 sent receipts per group in companion storage.
Oldest-first eviction advances CoverageLostBefore and never removes unresolved work.
fields.default: MaxHistory defaults to 10000 sent receipts per group in companion storage.

fields.name: MaxReservations
fields.doc:
MaxReservations defaults to 1000 per group. It caps saved Capture replies (at most one
minute) and persistent FlushOnce snapshots. Capture saves the state used for a flush;
FlushOnce snapshots survive retries. The same limit caps persistent FlushOnce requests
in the namespace slot. Persistent records are never evicted; a full registry rejects
new request IDs. MaxBytes also applies. Seal creates no reply receipt.
fields.default: MaxReservations defaults to 1000 per group.

fields.name: MaxBytes
fields.doc:
MaxBytes defaults to 32 MiB for the active group record. It excludes sent receipts and
durable flush receipts, which use companion storage. Each flush receipt is bounded by
32 * MaxBytes * (registered groups + 1). MaxReservations bounds the number of receipts.
Namespace scheduling leases have a separate 2 KiB allowance, so a full flush registry
can restart.
fields.default: MaxBytes defaults to 32 MiB for the active group record.

configs.name: redisstore.Config
configs.doc:
Config selects a key namespace. An optional namespace: prefix scopes keys to a shared
Redis ACL, for example myapp:prod. Use at most 32 lowercase letters, digits, underscores
or hyphens.

fields.name: Prefix
fields.doc:
Prefix defaults to quota; the unqualified prefix must match
[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_]{0,15}. See Config for the optional namespace.
fields.default: Prefix defaults to quota; the unqualified prefix must match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_]{0,15}. See Config for the optional namespace.

fields.name: Clock
fields.doc:
Clock is retained for isolated tests only and must be concurrency safe.
It replaces server time, including virtual expiry; nil uses Redis TIME.
fields.default: It replaces server time, including virtual expiry; nil uses Redis TIME.

configs.name: stripeadmin.Config
configs.doc:
Config selects the caller-owned status reader. Status and optional readers
are retained for the panel lifetime, never closed; all must be concurrency
safe and honor cancellation.

fields.name: Status
fields.doc:
Status is required, retained and caller-owned; it must honor ctx and
be concurrency safe.
fields.default: Status is required, retained and caller-owned; it must honor ctx and be concurrency safe.

fields.name: Inspection
fields.doc: Inspection enables bounded shared-store diagnostic views. Nil omits them.
fields.default: Nil omits them.

fields.name: Reconcile
fields.doc:
Reconcile enables a probe that compares exported totals with Stripe usage. Nil omits
the action.
fields.default: Nil omits the action.

fields.name: Flush
fields.doc:
Flush enables an action that seals and dispatches eligible usage through the local
dispatcher. The request is saved durably for retries. Nil omits the action.
fields.default: Nil omits the action.

fields.name: Budget
fields.doc: Budget bounds inspection; zero uses quotastripe defaults.
fields.default: Budget bounds inspection; zero uses quotastripe defaults.

fields.name: StripePages
fields.doc: StripePages defaults to 10 and must be 1–100. Shared across Probe retries.
fields.default: StripePages defaults to 10 and must be 1–100.

fields.name: ID
fields.doc:
ID defaults to stripe; use 1–32 lowercase ASCII letters, digits or
hyphens, starting with a letter, excluding api and assets.
fields.default: ID defaults to stripe; use 1–32 lowercase ASCII letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter, excluding api and assets.

fields.name: BacklogAlarm
fields.doc:
BacklogAlarm is a display threshold; defaults to 30m, nonzero values
must be positive.
fields.default: BacklogAlarm is a display threshold; defaults to 30m, nonzero values must be positive.

fields.name: Now
fields.doc: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.
fields.default: Now is retained and must be concurrency safe; nil uses time.Now.

configs.name: tenant.AuthorizeConfig
configs.doc:
AuthorizeConfig configures fail-closed resource authorization. Resource receives the deadline through the Echo request context. The
middleware restores the original context before calling the handler.
Resolver request changes and parsed form state are preserved. Callbacks must honor cancellation and be concurrency
safe; no detached work is started. Resolvers must establish resource
ownership, not merely operation ID, and must not retain the Echo context.

fields.name: Authorizer
fields.doc:
Authorizer is required, caller-owned and must be concurrency safe and
honor ctx.
fields.default: Authorizer is required, caller-owned and must be concurrency safe and honor ctx.

fields.name: Action
fields.doc: Action is required and contains 1–128 bytes.
fields.default: Action is required and contains 1–128 bytes.

fields.name: Resource
fields.doc:
Resource is a required, concurrency-safe resolver. It borrows the
Echo context for the call and must honor its request deadline.
fields.default: Resource is a required, concurrency-safe resolver.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.doc:
Timeout bounds resource resolution and authorization; defaults to 2s,
valid range 1ms–30s.
fields.default: Timeout bounds resource resolution and authorization; defaults to 2s, valid range 1ms–30s.

configs.name: tenant.CerbosConfig
configs.doc:
CerbosConfig requires an explicit trusted mapping, so arbitrary claims are
never forwarded. The adapter adds the resolved tenant as resource attr tenant.

fields.name: HTTP
fields.doc:
HTTP supplies the required client, origin and bounded request
settings.
fields.default: HTTP supplies the required client, origin and bounded request settings.

fields.name: Principal
fields.doc:
Principal is a required retained mapping and must be concurrency
safe. Returned roles and attributes are borrowed only during the
authorization call.
fields.default: Principal is a required retained mapping and must be concurrency safe.

configs.name: tenant.Config
configs.doc:
Config evaluates every selector and refuses conflicts. A credential
restriction supplies the tenant when selectors are absent. AnonymousSelector
explicitly permits public tenant addressing; ordinary selectors cannot confer
tenant authority on anonymous requests. Callbacks remain caller-owned and
concurrency safe.

fields.name: Selectors
fields.doc:
Selectors is copied; nil selects only a credential restriction.
At most 16 non-nil, concurrency-safe callbacks are accepted.
fields.default: Selectors is copied; nil selects only a credential restriction. At most 16 non-nil, concurrency-safe callbacks are accepted.

fields.name: Member
fields.doc:
Member checks authenticated principals only. If nil, it refuses request-selected
tenants unless the credential restricts the tenant. The callback is retained, must
support concurrent calls and must honor ctx. An error refuses the request, even when
Member also returns true.
fields.default: If nil, it refuses request-selected tenants unless the credential restricts the tenant.

fields.name: Required
fields.doc:
Required refuses an absent tenant except on public operations;
default false.
fields.default: Required refuses an absent tenant except on public operations; default false.

fields.name: AnonymousSelector
fields.doc:
AnonymousSelector is an optional retained selector for anonymous
traffic; nil disables anonymous tenant selection.
fields.default: AnonymousSelector is an optional retained selector for anonymous traffic; nil disables anonymous tenant selection.

configs.name: tenant.HTTPConfig
configs.doc:
HTTPConfig bounds a caller-owned client's authorization work. Responses are
limited to 64 KiB after decompression. Redirects must keep scheme and host,
with at most five hops. No retries or goroutines run. Service credentials are
never logged.

fields.name: Client
fields.doc:
Client is required and caller-owned. A shallow private copy shares
its transport and disables its cookie jar; configure it before
calling Cerbos or OpenFGA. Later field changes are not observed.
fields.default: Client is required and caller-owned.

fields.name: URL
fields.doc:
URL is a required http(s) origin without credentials, query or fragment. Plain http
supports private service meshes.
fields.default: URL is a required http(s) origin without credentials, query or fragment.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.doc:
Timeout defaults to 2s; valid range 1ms–30s, bounded by caller
cancellation.
fields.default: Timeout defaults to 2s; valid range 1ms–30s, bounded by caller cancellation.

fields.name: MaxConcurrent
fields.doc:
MaxConcurrent defaults to 16; valid range 1–256. Excess calls deny
immediately.
fields.default: MaxConcurrent defaults to 16; valid range 1–256.

fields.name: AuthHeader
fields.doc:
AuthHeader and AuthValue must be both empty or both set. AuthHeader is 1–64 ASCII
letters, digits or hyphens. AuthValue is at most 8192 bytes without CR or LF.
fields.default: AuthHeader and AuthValue must be both empty or both set.

fields.name: AuthValue
fields.doc:
AuthHeader and AuthValue must be both empty or both set. AuthHeader is 1–64 ASCII
letters, digits or hyphens. AuthValue is at most 8192 bytes without CR or LF.
fields.default: AuthHeader and AuthValue must be both empty or both set.

fields.name: AllowInsecure
fields.doc:
AllowInsecure permits credentials over HTTP for local tests; default
false.
fields.default: AllowInsecure permits credentials over HTTP for local tests; default false.

configs.name: tenant.OpenFGAConfig
configs.doc:
OpenFGAConfig pins the store and authorization model.
User optionally maps a trusted principal to a complete OpenFGA user; nil uses
user:<base32 principal ID>, avoiding ':'/'#' ambiguity in principal IDs.

fields.name: HTTP
fields.doc:
HTTP supplies the required client, origin and bounded request
settings.
fields.default: HTTP supplies the required client, origin and bounded request settings.

fields.name: StoreID
fields.doc:
StoreID and AuthorizationModelID are required, each 1–64 ASCII
letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
fields.default: StoreID and AuthorizationModelID are required, each 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

fields.name: AuthorizationModelID
fields.doc:
StoreID and AuthorizationModelID are required, each 1–64 ASCII
letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
fields.default: StoreID and AuthorizationModelID are required, each 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

fields.name: ActionRelations
fields.doc:
ActionRelations is copied; require 1–256 entries. Actions are 1–128
bytes; relations start with an ASCII letter or underscore followed by
up to 49 ASCII letters, digits or underscores. Missing actions deny.
fields.default: ActionRelations is copied; require 1–256 entries.

fields.name: User
fields.doc:
User is a retained, concurrency-safe mapping; nil selects the
default principal mapping described above. Its result must be a
valid OpenFGA user.
fields.default: User is a retained, concurrency-safe mapping; nil selects the default principal mapping described above.

configs.name: webhook.Endpoint

fields.name: URL
fields.doc: URL is required and has no default.
fields.default: URL is required and has no default.

fields.name: Secrets
fields.doc: Secrets is required; configure 1–8 signing secrets.
fields.default: Secrets is required; configure 1–8 signing secrets.

configs.name: webhook.HTTPSenderConfig
configs.doc:
HTTPSenderConfig configures an opt-in Standard Webhooks sender. The zero value is
invalid. Construction copies endpoints and decodes keys privately. The cloned transport
uses HTTP/1 without persistent connections, compression, redirects, cookies or automatic
retries.

fields.name: Endpoints
fields.doc:
Endpoints registers 1–64 destinations, keyed by Delivery.Destination.
Keep these keys in sync with the store Routing destinations.
Endpoints is required; configure 1–64 destinations.
fields.default: Endpoints is required; configure 1–64 destinations.

fields.name: Client
fields.doc:
Client is optional and caller-owned. Construction copies its settings and clones its
transport. Transport must be nil or *http.Transport. Neither may be mutated during
construction; neither is modified. A zero Timeout selects 15s. A positive Timeout is
preserved.
fields.default: Client is optional and caller-owned. Transport must be nil or *http.Transport. A zero Timeout selects 15s.

fields.name: Now
fields.doc: Now defaults to time.Now; a supplied clock must be concurrency safe.
fields.default: Now defaults to time.Now; a supplied clock must be concurrency safe.

fields.name: Logger
fields.doc:
Logger is optional, caller-owned and defaults to silence. Logs contain
only outcome and machine code, never endpoint or delivery IDs.
fields.default: Logger is optional, caller-owned and defaults to silence.

configs.name: webhook.ReceiveConfig
configs.doc:
ReceiveConfig configures terminal ingress middleware for one dedicated route.
The zero value is invalid.

The middleware retains Inbox and Verify without closing them.
Keep them and their stores and keys usable while the middleware serves requests.
Both callbacks and their dependencies must support concurrent calls.
The adapter sets the connection's read deadline to Timeout through http.ResponseController.
If the response writer cannot set deadlines, your server must limit body reads to Timeout or less.
Cancelling a context cannot interrupt a blocked body read.
Logs contain only the source, status and a fixed reason code.

fields.name: Inbox
fields.doc:
Inbox is required, caller-owned and must be concurrency safe and
honor ctx.
fields.default: Inbox is required, caller-owned and must be concurrency safe and honor ctx.

fields.name: Source
fields.doc:
Source is the required registered source name, 1–64 printable ASCII
bytes. It must equal every Verify result's Source.
fields.default: Source is the required registered source name, 1–64 printable ASCII bytes.

fields.name: Verify
fields.doc:
Verify is required, retained and must be concurrency safe and honor
ctx.
fields.default: Verify is required, retained and must be concurrency safe and honor ctx.

fields.name: MaxBodyBytes
fields.doc: MaxBodyBytes defaults to 256 KiB; valid range 1 byte–1 MiB.
fields.default: MaxBodyBytes defaults to 256 KiB; valid range 1 byte–1 MiB.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.doc:
Timeout bounds body reads, verification and acceptance from adapter
entry; zero uses 5s, valid range 1–8s. See ReceiveConfig for
body-read deadline requirements.
fields.default: Timeout bounds body reads, verification and acceptance from adapter entry; zero uses 5s, valid range 1–8s.

fields.name: Logger
fields.doc: Logger is optional and caller-owned; nil is silent.
fields.default: Logger is optional and caller-owned; nil is silent.

configs.name: webhook.StandardVerifierConfig
configs.doc:
StandardVerifierConfig configures HMAC Standard Webhooks verification for one
trusted route. The zero value is invalid. Unverified headers and payloads cannot select tenant, account, type or
format. For dynamic mappings, wrap VerifyFunc and parse only after
verification succeeds.

fields.name: Secrets
fields.doc:
Secrets uses Endpoint's whsec_ form and bounds; any matching key verifies.
Secrets is required; configure 1–8 verification secrets.
fields.default: Secrets is required; configure 1–8 verification secrets.

fields.name: Tenant
fields.doc:
Source, Type and Format are required. They name the source, event type and payload
format assigned to every verified message. Tenant and Account bind the route to trusted
application values and may be empty.
fields.default: Source, Type and Format are required. Tenant and Account bind the route to trusted application values and may be empty.

fields.name: Source
fields.doc:
Source, Type and Format are required. They name the source, event type and payload
format assigned to every verified message. Tenant and Account bind the route to trusted
application values and may be empty.
fields.default: Source, Type and Format are required. Tenant and Account bind the route to trusted application values and may be empty.

fields.name: Account
fields.doc:
Source, Type and Format are required. They name the source, event type and payload
format assigned to every verified message. Tenant and Account bind the route to trusted
application values and may be empty.
fields.default: Source, Type and Format are required. Tenant and Account bind the route to trusted application values and may be empty.

fields.name: Type
fields.doc:
Source, Type and Format are required. They name the source, event type and payload
format assigned to every verified message. Tenant and Account bind the route to trusted
application values and may be empty.
fields.default: Source, Type and Format are required. Tenant and Account bind the route to trusted application values and may be empty.

fields.name: Format
fields.doc:
Source, Type and Format are required. They name the source, event type and payload
format assigned to every verified message. Tenant and Account bind the route to trusted
application values and may be empty.
fields.default: Source, Type and Format are required. Tenant and Account bind the route to trusted application values and may be empty.

fields.name: Tolerance
fields.doc:
Tolerance defaults to 5m; valid range 1s–5m, on either side of Now.
Timestamp checking limits replay age; the inbox must deduplicate IDs.
fields.default: Tolerance defaults to 5m; valid range 1s–5m, on either side of Now.

fields.name: Now
fields.doc: Now defaults to time.Now; a supplied clock must be concurrency safe.
fields.default: Now defaults to time.Now; a supplied clock must be concurrency safe.

configs.name: webhookadmin.Config
configs.doc:
Config selects one caller-owned store. The zero ID is "webhook"; Store has
no default, so the zero Config is invalid.

fields.name: ID
fields.doc:
ID is the panel ID: 1–32 bytes of [a-z0-9-] starting with a letter, not
"api" or "assets". It defaults to "webhook". Use a distinct ID for each namespace. Change the ID or console Keys when
switching that location to another namespace. Cursors bind the panel ID
rather than the store.
fields.default: It defaults to "webhook".

fields.name: Store
fields.doc:
Store is an already constructed, caller-owned store from webhookpg.New
on the runtime-role pool. The panel never migrates, closes or
reconfigures it. Keep the store and its pool open while any console using the panel serves
requests.
Required.
fields.default: Required.

fields.name: EnableReplay
fields.doc:
EnableReplay explicitly enables audited replay, unknown-outcome decisions
and payload reveal. The default
panel exposes reads only. Mounting an enabled panel requires console Keys
and an Audit sink (or the explicit AllowUnauditedWrites opt-out).
fields.default: The default panel exposes reads only. Mounting an enabled panel requires console Keys and an Audit sink (or the explicit AllowUnauditedWrites opt-out).

configs.name: webhookmem.DestinationConfig
configs.doc:
DestinationConfig registers a versioned outgoing destination, with the same
policy and defaults as webhookpg.DestinationConfig. Send is caller-owned,
retained, concurrency safe and must honor cancellation. ReplayWindow is the
receiver's deduplication horizon, greater than RequestTimeout + 5m and at most
30 days. RequestTimeout defaults to 15s, valid range 1–30s.

fields.name: Version
fields.doc: Version is required; configure the immutable routing version.
fields.default: Version is required; configure the immutable routing version.

fields.name: Send
fields.doc: Send is required, retained and caller-owned.
fields.default: Send is required, retained and caller-owned.

fields.name: ReplayWindow
fields.doc: ReplayWindow is required and has no default.
fields.default: ReplayWindow is required and has no default.

fields.name: RequestTimeout
fields.doc: RequestTimeout defaults to 15s; valid range 1s–30s.
fields.default: RequestTimeout defaults to 15s; valid range 1s–30s.

configs.name: webhookmem.RoutingConfig
configs.doc:
RoutingConfig freezes outgoing routing and retry policy. Destinations is
copied (at most 64). MaxAttempts defaults to 8, range 1–32. MaxAge defaults to
72h, range 1m–7 days. Logger is optional, caller-owned and silent when nil.
Callbacks and logger must be safe for concurrent use.

fields.name: Destinations
fields.doc: Destinations is optional; nil registers none, with at most 64 entries.
fields.default: Destinations is optional; nil registers none, with at most 64 entries.

fields.name: MaxAttempts
fields.doc: MaxAttempts defaults to 8; valid range 1–32 attempts per cycle.
fields.default: MaxAttempts defaults to 8; valid range 1–32 attempts per cycle.

fields.name: MaxAge
fields.doc: MaxAge defaults to 72h; valid range 1m–7 days per cycle.
fields.default: MaxAge defaults to 72h; valid range 1m–7 days per cycle.

fields.name: Logger
fields.doc: Logger is optional and caller-owned. Nil logs nothing.
fields.default: Logger is optional and caller-owned. Nil logs nothing.

configs.name: webhookmem.StoreConfig
configs.doc:
StoreConfig bounds live records plus terminal records inside their duplicate
window. Namespace defaults to "default"; each Store is independent. MaxMessages
defaults to 1,000 (range 1–100,000); MaxBytes defaults to 16 MiB (range 1 KiB–1 GiB). Logical bytes charge payload and all outgoing strings plus 512 bytes
per record, not Go heap usage. Terminal records expire at first intent plus
ReplayWindow (enqueue time plus ReplayWindow if never sent). Store operations
reclaim expired terminal records; live records are never evicted.

fields.name: Namespace
fields.doc: Namespace defaults to default. Each memory store is independent.
fields.default: Namespace defaults to default.

fields.name: MaxMessages
fields.doc: MaxMessages defaults to 1000; valid range 1–100000.
fields.default: MaxMessages defaults to 1000; valid range 1–100000.

fields.name: MaxBytes
fields.doc:
MaxBytes defaults to 16 MiB; valid range 1 KiB–1 GiB. This counts logical bytes, not
heap usage.
fields.default: MaxBytes defaults to 16 MiB; valid range 1 KiB–1 GiB.

fields.name: Routing
fields.doc: Routing at zero registers no destinations and uses the RoutingConfig retry defaults.
fields.default: Routing at zero registers no destinations and uses the RoutingConfig retry defaults.

configs.name: webhookmem.WorkerConfig
configs.doc:
WorkerConfig bounds Run. Concurrency defaults to 16 (1–64); PollInterval
defaults to 250ms (50ms–5s); ShutdownTimeout defaults to 30s (1–60s).
Unlike webhookpg there is no batch acquisition or idle polling backoff.

fields.name: Concurrency
fields.doc: Concurrency defaults to 16; valid range 1–64.
fields.default: Concurrency defaults to 16; valid range 1–64.

fields.name: PollInterval
fields.doc: PollInterval defaults to 250ms; valid range 50ms–5s.
fields.default: PollInterval defaults to 250ms; valid range 50ms–5s.

fields.name: ShutdownTimeout
fields.doc: ShutdownTimeout defaults to 30s; valid range 1s–60s.
fields.default: ShutdownTimeout defaults to 30s; valid range 1s–60s.

configs.name: webhookpg.DestinationConfig
configs.doc: DestinationConfig registers one outgoing destination.

fields.name: Version
fields.doc:
Version is required, immutable and 1–64 printable ASCII bytes. It
defines the payload and routing rules and must equal every enqueued
message's Version.
fields.default: Version is required, immutable and 1–64 printable ASCII bytes.

fields.name: Send
fields.doc:
Send is required, retained and must be concurrency safe and honor
ctx.
fields.default: Send is required, retained and must be concurrency safe and honor ctx.

fields.name: ReplayWindow
fields.doc:
ReplayWindow is the receiver's documented deduplication horizon;
required, greater than RequestTimeout + 5m and at most 30 days.
fields.default: ReplayWindow is the receiver's documented deduplication horizon; required, greater than RequestTimeout + 5m and at most 30 days.

fields.name: RequestTimeout
fields.doc:
RequestTimeout defaults to 15s; valid range 1–30s, stored to
millisecond precision.
fields.default: RequestTimeout defaults to 15s; valid range 1–30s, stored to millisecond precision.

configs.name: webhookpg.RoutingConfig
configs.doc:
RoutingConfig is StoreConfig.Routing: the registered routes and the retry
policy frozen into new records. Sources maps a source name to its processor;
Destinations maps a destination name to its registration. Retries back off
from 1s to at most 5m with equal jitter. The Worker logs only fixed messages
with direction, route, outcome, code and error-class fields.

fields.name: Sources
fields.doc:
Sources is copied; nil registers none. At most 64 named processors
are accepted; callbacks are retained for the Store's lifetime and
must be concurrency safe.
fields.default: Sources is copied; nil registers none.

fields.name: Destinations
fields.doc:
Destinations is copied; nil registers none. At most 64 named
destinations are accepted. Names in both maps are 1–64 printable
ASCII bytes.
fields.default: Destinations is copied; nil registers none.

fields.name: MaxAttempts
fields.doc:
MaxAttempts defaults to 8 per cycle; valid range 1–32.
At most 32 attempts are permitted in total.
fields.default: MaxAttempts defaults to 8 per cycle; valid range 1–32.

fields.name: MaxAge
fields.doc: MaxAge defaults to 72h per cycle; valid range 1m–7 days.
fields.default: MaxAge defaults to 72h per cycle; valid range 1m–7 days.

fields.name: ProcessTimeout
fields.doc: ProcessTimeout defaults to 5s; valid range 1–15s.
fields.default: ProcessTimeout defaults to 5s; valid range 1–15s.

fields.name: Logger
fields.doc:
Logger is retained for the Store's lifetime and caller-owned; nil is
silent. It must be concurrency safe.
fields.default: Logger is retained for the Store's lifetime and caller-owned; nil is silent.

configs.name: webhookpg.StoreConfig
configs.doc:
StoreConfig selects storage and policy. Use keyed literals: fields may be
added. Namespace, caps and retention are persisted by Migrate and must match
in New. An earlier caller deadline or cancellation still ends an operation
first.

New and Migrate validate both timeout settings. An out-of-range value
prevents either call from succeeding. New uses Timeout as its deadline.
Migrate uses MigrateTimeout. Migrate neither
validates nor uses Routing; New, the Store and its Workers use it.

fields.name: Schema
fields.doc:
Schema defaults to public (1–63 UTF-8 bytes without NUL); Namespace
defaults to "default" (1–64 printable ASCII bytes).
fields.default: Schema defaults to public (1–63 UTF-8 bytes without NUL); Namespace defaults to "default" (1–64 printable ASCII bytes).

fields.name: Namespace
fields.doc:
Schema defaults to public (1–63 UTF-8 bytes without NUL); Namespace
defaults to "default" (1–64 printable ASCII bytes).
fields.default: Schema defaults to public (1–63 UTF-8 bytes without NUL); Namespace defaults to "default" (1–64 printable ASCII bytes).

fields.name: Timeout
fields.doc:
Timeout bounds New and each Store operation; defaults to 5s, valid
range 1–30s.
fields.default: Timeout bounds New and each Store operation; defaults to 5s, valid range 1–30s.

fields.name: MigrateTimeout
fields.doc:
MigrateTimeout bounds the whole migration in place of Timeout;
defaults to 1m, valid range 1s–1h.
fields.default: MigrateTimeout bounds the whole migration in place of Timeout; defaults to 1m, valid range 1s–1h.

fields.name: MaxMessages
fields.doc: MaxMessages defaults to 100,000; valid range 1–10,000,000.
fields.default: MaxMessages defaults to 100,000; valid range 1–10,000,000.

fields.name: MaxBytes
fields.doc: MaxBytes defaults to 512 MiB; valid range 1 MiB–1 TiB.
fields.default: MaxBytes defaults to 512 MiB; valid range 1 MiB–1 TiB.

fields.name: PayloadRetention
fields.doc:
PayloadRetention defaults to 7 days; must be positive and at most
DedupeRetention.
fields.default: PayloadRetention defaults to 7 days; must be positive and at most DedupeRetention.

fields.name: DedupeRetention
fields.doc: DedupeRetention defaults to 30 days; valid range 30–365 days.
fields.default: DedupeRetention defaults to 30 days; valid range 30–365 days.

fields.name: Routing
fields.doc:
Routing is validated and copied by New; Migrate ignores it. The zero value registers no
routes and uses RoutingConfig retry defaults in New.
fields.default: The zero value registers no routes and uses RoutingConfig retry defaults in New.

configs.name: webhookpg.WorkerConfig
configs.doc:
WorkerConfig configures one Worker and bounds its Run; the zero value selects
every default. Routing, callbacks, retry policy and the logger come from the
Store's StoreConfig.Routing. A claim never exceeds the free slots. Idle and
failed polls back off with equal jitter up to max(PollInterval, 5s) and reset
on work.

fields.name: Concurrency
fields.doc:
Concurrency fixes the worker count and caps claimed or in-flight
records; defaults to 16, valid range 1–64.
fields.default: Concurrency fixes the worker count and caps claimed or in-flight records; defaults to 16, valid range 1–64.

fields.name: BatchSize
fields.doc:
BatchSize caps one claim; defaults to min(8, Concurrency),
valid range 1–min(16, Concurrency).
fields.default: BatchSize caps one claim; defaults to min(8, Concurrency), valid range 1–min(16, Concurrency).

fields.name: PollInterval
fields.doc:
PollInterval is the base idle wait; defaults to 250ms, valid range
50ms–5s.
fields.default: PollInterval is the base idle wait; defaults to 250ms, valid range 50ms–5s.

fields.name: ShutdownTimeout
fields.doc:
ShutdownTimeout bounds the drain after cancellation; defaults to 30s,
valid range 1–60s. See Worker.Run for shutdown behavior.
fields.default: ShutdownTimeout bounds the drain after cancellation; defaults to 30s, valid range 1–60s.
